page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a centred-left heading at the top. No marginal notes are visible. The left part of the page is obscured by a dark shadow. A digitiser's watermark at the lower right is omitted.

main_text.head: ad Lectorem.
main_text.p: n Praefatione Consensus veritatis Doctoribus, Pastoribus, Synodis, damnant, hoc le dedille infirmi-erae conscientiae, ut priorem ul-ndi modum mutaverint, substi-ormula, &c. Et qua veritate, ia, dicat; Veritati & Autoritati, ræ, si non plus, saltem non mi-re Cartesianos, atque adversarios, le intellecta suos errores conan-re, ei, quod nobis suis puerl, affin-ilium opinionibus suis co[?] eni-identur ad quos id spectat. Sed e du-[illegible, ~3 letters] vitam. Ad rem.
[?]e, ne quis sit qui vos deprede-Philosophiam & inanem se-m secundum traditionem ho-secundum elementa mundi; cundum Christum.

page.notes: The left third of the page is in deep shadow, so the initial letters of many lines are lost or doubtful. Marked [?] where guessed. The line beginning "n Praefatione" may be a fragment of a longer line. The line "Col. 11. 8." is a reference, not a heading. The line "vitam. Ad rem." is partly unreadable and the reading is uncertain. The word "dedille" is copied as printed.
